title: Can Programs Replace LLM Judges? Executable Program Judges for Scalable and Efficient Relevance Labeling
abstract: arXiv:2611.24849v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) judges have become a common way to create large-scale relevance judgments for retrieval evaluation. However, each judgment requires a potentially expensive call to a frontier model, and the judgments are hard to interpret and may not be reproducible. In this paper, we ask whether an LLM can write a readable program for each topic that replaces its per-document judgments. To address these issues, we propose ExecJudges, a method for generating fast, inspectable and scalable judges for automatic relevance labeling. Specifically, ExecJudges uses a frontier LLM to turn assessment guidelines into executable programs, which rely only on lexical matching, standard NLP libraries like parsers, and pool statistics. An ExecJudges-L variant also uses examples of human labels if available. translated_title: 程序能否取代大语言模型裁判？用于可扩展且高效相关性标注的可执行程序裁判
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）裁判已成为为检索评估创建大规模相关性判断的常用方法。然而，每次判断都需要对前沿模型进行可能代价高昂的调用，且这些判断难以解释，并可能无法复现。在本文中，我们探讨LLM能否为每个主题编写一个可读的程序，以取代其对每个文档逐一进行判断的方式。为解决这些问题，我们提出了ExecJudges，一种用于自动相关性标注的方法，可生成快速、可检查且可扩展的裁判。具体而言，ExecJudges使用前沿LLM将评估指南转化为可执行程序，这些程序仅依赖词汇匹配、标准NLP库（如解析器）以及池统计信息。ExecJudges-L变体在可用时还会利用人工标注的示例。我们在七个TREC数据集合上评估了ExecJudges，通过将生成的标签与训练有素的NIST评估员、前沿LLM裁判以及（原文在此处截断）进行比较。
tldr: 提出ExecJudges方法，利用前沿LLM将评估指南转化为仅依赖词汇匹配和标准NLP库的可执行程序，从而取代昂贵的LLM裁判调用，实现快速、可解释、可复现的大规模相关性标注。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ExecJudges, a method that uses frontier LLMs to convert assessment guidelines into fast, inspectable executable programs relying only on lexical matching and standard NLP libraries, replacing costly LLM judge calls for scalable and reproducible relevance labeling.
